principle: All protected services remain replaceable adapters. No external service controls the product engine.

adapters.purpose: Map an authenticated institutional user to a pseudonymous learner_ref and role.
adapters.pii_boundary: PII stays in the protected identity service; the learning automation engine receives only pseudonymous references.
adapters.note: Admin-authorized pseudonymous learner access tokens are built. Institution-specific SSO/identity mapping can remain outside the learning engine.

adapters.purpose: Provision and deactivate pseudonymous learners for an institutional cohort.
adapters.note: Protected roster provisioning accepts learner_ref + role only and enforces institutional seat limits.

adapters.purpose: Confirm paid entitlement without exposing payment credentials to the learning engine.
adapters.note: Active institutional licences automatically entitle provisioned learners. Consumer iKhokha checkout remains separately gated.

adapters.purpose: Consume reminder and governance outbox actions and deliver approved email/SMS/app notifications.
adapters.note: Learner/action outbox is built; email/SMS/app push requires a delivery adapter.

adapters.purpose: Issue an identity-aware IZAKHONO completion credential after eligibility and protected identity verification.
adapters.note: Signed completion records are built without PII. Named identity-aware certificates still require a protected identity adapter.

adapters.purpose: Consume aggregated institutional progress and completion events for dashboards and exports.
adapters.note: Protected institution-level aggregate reporting API is built; external BI/dashboard export is optional.
